learning.title: Real-API specs skip silently, and real-Codex cases run whenever codex is on PATH
learning.trigger: A lane is green but real-API or real-harness specs reported skipped, or a local security, integration or e2e run starts on a machine that has codex installed and logged in.
learning.mistake: Counted a skipped real-API spec as a pass, or (before #207) ran a local lane with codex on PATH and unknowingly ran a real Codex case against the operator's own login and billing.
learning.rule: Real-API Playwright projects are selected by environment only: BAKERY_REAL_API=1, plus BAKERY_REAL_API_COORDINATOR=1 (desktop-real-api), BAKERY_REAL_API_HARNESS=1 (real harness) or BAKERY_REAL_API_M1=1 (M1 proof). Without them the specs are skipped and the run still exits 0. A skipped real-API spec is a failed check: require zero skipped. Real-CLI conformance cases name their skip as [skipped: reason] and warn; a skip is never a pass.

The security, integration and e2e lanes skip the real-Codex harness cases unless BAKERY_TEST_CODEX_AUTH_DIR names a dedicated test credential directory: absolute, existing, holding its own auth.json, and never the operator's own login or inside it (#207). CODEX_HOME, BAKERY_CODEX_AUTH_SOURCE_DIR and HOME/.codex are not opt-ins and are never read for these cases; the gate returns its skip reason before it even runs codex --version. With the variable set, the probe and the cases see only that directory. A skipped real-Codex case is not a pass, so report ignored counts with passed counts. Setting BAKERY_PROVIDER_REAL_CLI makes scripts/run-tests.ts add bare --allow-run and --allow-net to the provider lane, so pass the single file path and never set it in CI.

verification.requirement: Report passed and skipped counts together. Real-API or real-harness evidence needs the opt-in variables set and zero skipped; fixture runs show the real-Codex cases as ignored with the BAKERY_TEST_CODEX_AUTH_DIR reason, and the rail fails if any test reaches the operator login another way.

learning.boundary: Real runs spend the operator's quota and are maintainer-gated evidence; fixtures never prove them. See pr-ci-never-runs-full-lanes for lanes that CI skips by routing.
